document.abstract: At its 26th meeting, on 10 September 1974, the Satellite Technical and Operational Committee—Television (STOC—TV), having discussed the need for standardized operational graticules for oscilloscopes used to check the technical quality of long-distance connections containing links by satellite, decided to form, an ad hoc subcommittee for such graticules. STOC—TV was established in North America in 1967 in recognition of the need to develop unified operating practices, technical quality criteria, and standards for international television connections using communications satellites. Its membership comprises companies operating intercontinental satellite links and domestic satellite systems and, also, major terrestrial common carriers and broadcasting networks in the US. and Canada.
